_comment: A hand-built response shaped to match Yahoo's well-documented (but unofficial/undocumented) v8/finance/chart JSON — this sandbox is IP-blocked by Yahoo (DATA-SOURCES.md), so this could not be captured from a live call this session. Shape confidence: indicators.adjclose[0].adjclose as an array parallel to indicators.quote[0].close, present by default for daily-interval requests with no extra query param, is long-standing behavior of this exact endpoint (the same field the yfinance Python library reads). close and adjclose are DELIBERATELY different values below so a parser test can prove it reads adjclose specifically, not close. Six points (not fewer) so the response also clears the real code's >5-point truncated-response guard, same threshold js/api.js's fetchHistory() uses.
